nodes.title: Round d34 on the merged tree, dry (no model): three branches that each read 0 alone flagged six kinds of turn together; after to-brain 052 and main's script fixes the nine topics (seven live, two staged; 36 lessons) read 0 on every gated predicate
The card's own reason is one rung of help, not the ladder: after the named wrong answer the own reason, then the card's hint on the next miss, then the key

On the third turn or later at one question, a turn that parks or answers a side-topic ends on an invitation that points at the open question ("Pehle is sawaal ka jawab do."), never the question again and never the bare "Ab tum batao."
A card's Hindi form said because the child asked for Hindi ends its turn whatever the count at that question; no invitation is said after a question
Named wrong answers at asked worked steps stay unread: a miss there is told the step, and the checker notes a reason nobody will hear
Where two told lines of a worked example share a turn and their result boards do not fit the turn together, the script gives them one board that shows both; never a check-in between them
The line said when no other picture is left says what is on the board ("Board par jo hai, wahi iski poori tasveer hai."), never what was not made; the checker refuses the refusal shape
The checker counts a turn with the engine's own function and limit; a verdict, short reason, point and card the walk would split is a checker error
A list the lesson engine reads lives under data/ as JSON, read by engine and checker alike; the engine never reads scripts/ or parses source
c4-maths-ch01-t02 (right angles, comparing angles, the circle) is the seventh live lesson from release 58, having passed director33 at its third attempt

Two code branches and a script branch each ended on a clean dry check; merged, the same check flagged six kinds of turn (a split after a right answer, a key before the hint, a told step over the posing board, a board change not drawn, a refusal-shaped no-picture line, a Hindi request with spent help): the dry matrix on the merged tree is a build step of its own, with a follow-up order after it

The checker counted tokens holding a letter or digit and the engine every token, so "+", "=" and "×" were words to one and not the other: a turn the checker passed at 53 of 61 was 71 to the walk, which split it after a right answer (c6-ch06 s2 e1, three dry lessons)

Main's Learning 022 part D told an author to cut four c5-t02 remediations that an earlier ruling (Learning 018, the checker's REM_WHOLE list) says are said whole; the cut lines read as notes and were restored: an order to an author is checked against the lists that already rule on its lines

to-brain 052 B1 as first built read the checker's list by parsing scripts/ source, which the web image does not ship: every test passed and production would have read an empty list; caught from the builder's own report, not by a test

Counting the Hindi form toward the question cap made the walk say "Ab tum batao." straight after the Hindi question on a third turn (11 dry rows); every predicate read 0 because the turn ended on an allowed form; found by main reading the dry rows against the letter of the judges' prompt (director33 decision item 11)

A container restart stopped two builders mid-part; a message to each agent id resumed it with its context and its uncommitted edits in place, and a compound shell command (heredoc and nohup in one call) left another agent waiting 20 minutes on an approval nobody could give: agents use plain commands, commit per part, and are resumed, not relaunched
A result board on each of two worked steps that are said in one turn with the child's own step: three boards pass the whiteboard's limit for a turn and the second line is said over the first's board

No-picture lines that say what was not made ("Iske liye doosri tasveer nahi bani hai."): five scripts carried one as their third form; it is the refusal Brain 048 G5 rules out and the dry check flags it only when the rotation reaches it

md.measurements: - `ms-r8-d34-merged-dry` (2026-11-24): the dry matrix (no model; reactive rule-based child; four children per topic) on the merged round-d34 tree. **First merge** (to-brain 051 parts A and B and Learning 022, each branch clean alone), six live topics, 24 lessons: check exit 1 on three kinds of gated flag: a verdict-point-card turn split with its first half ending on a go-on line (c6-ch06 offtopic 44, steering 46, stuck 62), a Hindi request with spent help flagged for lacking the easier-words line (c6-ch07-t01 offtopic 32), a key before the card's hint after the own reason (c5-t03 steady 58). Three staged topics, 12 lessons: a told step said over the posing board (5 rows), a planned board change not drawn (4), a refusal-shaped no-picture line (1). **After to-brain 052** (two builders in parallel, a closing builder) **and main's script fixes**: seven live topics and two staged, 36 lessons, check exit 0 on both; counted, not gated: a verdict, reason, point and card said whole in 66 to 70 words 10; a card's sentence in two turns running 15; a re-ask with no authored form 13; a worked step's reason said again 9; a point ending on its check-in 4; a close and next card that do not join 1. Of 45 picture requests: 11 the card's authored picture, 22 the board's second view, 4 the no-other-drawing line with the hint over the board up, 8 that line and the invitation; 0 board changes inside a no-picture turn. Invitations: 88 in 36 lessons, at most 5 in one (two stuck lessons); pointed invitations 6; easier-words lines 6. Counts baseline rewritten once (654 moved paths, each attributed to a part of 051 or 052: `tests/r7-dry-matrix.test.mjs`). Whole unit suite on the merged tree: 807 test files in 81 batches, 7,965 tests pass, 0 fail, 13 skipped (database tests with no database), 2 todo; tsc and the prompt budget pass. Method: `evals/hybrid-side-by-side.mjs --matrix --director-only --reactive --dry`, `check-run.mjs`; main read one steady and one stuck lesson in full and every row of the no-picture, invitation and Hindi rules against the judges' prompt. Not measured: anything a model says (the paid run director34 does that).
md.decisions:
- `dc-r8-own-reason-is-one-rung` (2026-11-24, main; to-brain 052 A1): at a card with a hint, the named wrong answer gets the card's own reason and the question again; the next miss gets the card's `simpler`; the miss after that the key. A first miss that is another answer gets the hint first. **Why:** director33's decision made the own reason follow only its named answer; as built the same answer twice went reason then key and the card's hint was never said (c5-t03 steady 58), which the gate of 049 B3 forbids. **Reverses if** two judges read the hint after the own reason as one help too many at a card of three options or fewer; there the key follows the own reason.
- `dc-r8-pointed-invitation-on-third-turn` (2026-11-24, main; 052 B4): on the third turn or later at one question, a turn that parks a side-topic or replies to one ends on `joints.answerFirst` or one of three code forms ("Pehle is sawaal ka jawab do."); the question comes back when the child answers it, asks for it or asks for help. **Why:** the cap of director33 item 6 forbade the bare invitation after a park and the question a third time, and left nothing to say: the staged offtopic lesson asked one question five turns running. **Reverses if** two judges hear the pointed invitation as scolding a child for the side-topic; then it is said once and the question returns the turn after.
- `dc-r8-hindi-form-on-request-ends-turn` (2026-11-24, main): where the child asks for Hindi at a card that has a Hindi form, the turn is the switch line and the form and ends on the form whatever the count; it counts as a turn at that question for what follows. A gated predicate flags any invitation said straight after a question. **Why:** `fd-r8-cap-tacked-invitation-after-hindi-question`. **Reverses if** a judge counts a child held at one question by repeated Hindi requests; then the second Hindi request at a card gets the easier-words help, not the form again.
- `dc-r8-asked-step-marks-unread` (2026-11-24, main; 052 B3): `wrongIfMis` and `whyAlt` on an asked worked step are not read; a miss is told the step; the checker prints a note where a step carries a reason (7 places in three scripts). **Why:** the told line is the correction, and a reason before it makes a three-part turn inside a worked example. **Reverses if** a judge cites a step miss where the told line does not meet the child's named wrong answer.
- `dc-r8-told-lines-in-one-turn-share-a-board` (2026-11-24, main): `rj-r8-result-board-per-told-step-in-one-turn`. The script gives both steps one result board that shows what both lines say (staged c6-ch07-t03 s1: 8 with 6, 4 with 3, 12 with 9); the child's own step keeps its board. **Reverses if** a judge finds the shared board settles the child's own step that follows, or shows the second line's result before the first is understood; then the second line becomes part of the own step's turn and the first ends on the asked step alone.
- `dc-r8-no-picture-line-says-what-is-drawn` (2026-11-24, main; 052 A6): five scripts' third no-picture form reworded; `PICTURE_REFUSAL` (one exported pattern, reading "drawing" and "picture" as "tasveer") is a checker error on `joints.noPicture`. **Reverses if** two judges hear "Board par jo hai, wahi iski poori tasveer hai." as not answering a child who asked for another picture; then each script keeps only its first form ("Iski aur koi tasveer mere paas nahi hai.").
- `dc-r8-one-word-count` (2026-11-24, main; 052 A5): `wordsIn` and `VPC_MAX` are exported by the engine and used by the checker; opener 3 + short reason + lead-in 1 + point + card above 70 is an error for the nine scripts (highest now 69). **Why:** `fd-r8-checker-and-engine-counted-words-differently`. **Reverses if** the engine's limit moves; the checker follows it by import, so only a change of what is counted (a different opener length) needs this entry changed.
- `dc-r8-engine-lists-live-in-data` (2026-11-24, main): the REM_WHOLE list is `data/lesson-rem-whole.json`. **Why:** `fd-r8-engine-read-a-list-production-does-not-ship`. **Reverses if** the image starts shipping `scripts/`; even then a JSON read stays simpler than parsing source.
- `dc-r8-c4-ch01-t02-live` (2026-11-24, main; clause 16 of director33): moved to `data/lesson-scripts/` with this round's fixes under main's rulings (the aaram kursi card, conditional tester lines, the no-picture line); lists in the checker and 17 tests follow. **Reverses if** it fails a gate line in director34 for a cause in its script (clause 53): it returns to staged; a release is rolled back only for a false key or a misgrade.
md.rejected:
- `rj-r8-result-board-per-told-step-in-one-turn` (2026-11-24): **tried** (Learning 022 rule 2 as authored, to-brain 051 C2 and 052 A2 as built) giving each worked step its own `resultBoard` where step 1 is asked and step 2 is told in the same turn as the child's own step. **What broke:** the turn held three boards (24, 12 and 12 parts), over the whiteboard's 120-operation limit for one turn; the walk's guard said step 2's line over step 1's board, whose 4-bar was empty while she said "6 rangeen mil kar 3" (staged c6-ch07-t03: offtopic 16, steady 24, steering 34, stuck 24). Splitting the turn needs a check-in inside a worked example, which 047 R4 forbids. Replaced by `dc-r8-told-lines-in-one-turn-share-a-board`.
- `rj-r8-refusal-shaped-no-picture-lines` (2026-11-24): **tried** (authors' third forms in five scripts) "Iske liye doosri tasveer nahi bani hai." and its kin as the line for a picture request with nothing left. **What broke:** it says what was not made, the refusal Brain 048 G5 rules out; the dry check flagged it only in the one lesson whose rotation reached the third form (staged c4-ch06-t01 stuck 18), and three more were missed by a pattern that read only "tasveer". Replaced by `dc-r8-no-picture-line-says-what-is-drawn`.
